district_name: Champlain Islands Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(1)(C) inventory: the Champlain Islands Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Grand Isle Supervisory Union (member towns Grand Isle, Isle La Motte, North Hero).

board.org_name: Champlain Islands Unified Union School Board

sources.note: Town of Grand Isle official return of votes, March 3, 2026: 'UNIFIED UNION BOARD MEMBER - 3 YEARS -- ANDREW BAHRENBURG, GRAND ISLE, 408'. Directors are elected by each member town on its own ballot (the Town of North Hero's March 2026 warning likewise warns a district 'representative for a term of three years'), the proportional-to-town pattern (16 V.S.A. section 730(a)(1)).

Grand Isle Supervisory Union (official). The district's 2016 articles of agreement could not be retrieved (the AOE study-committee copies return 403 and the SU document library is script-driven), so the board's size and allocation -- six seats, observed as two per member town across 2020-2024 district minutes -- are modeled as OBSERVED, not articles-confirmed, and all memberships except the one certified 2026 winner are held: the last complete official roster is from 2023-24 minutes and two election cycles have intervened.
